The two equality targets identify rounded multiplication. None asserts a backward-error equality for roundedDotProduct or a gamma(depth+1,u) bound. The algorithm itself is fully defined: one rounded multiplication per leaf and one rounded addition per internal node. These constructions satisfy the requested algorithm policy, and existential perturbations need no executable construction. The translated product-stage assertions follow from the relative-error model already present in the source setting, but do not establish the full requested result without additional proofs.
